name: Refinery / Commons
pitch_50: Research-software infrastructure that keeps capabilities, implementations, claims, runs, experiments, and promotion decisions distinct so evidence remains attached to the exact subject it supports.
description: The proposed SSI Fellowship activity turns two bounded reuse experiments into an open teaching case, evidence checklist, and two online clinics. One experiment produced equal 42-of-42 results for reuse and rebuild. A Public Suffix List task produced 78-of-78 for licensed reuse and 39-of-78 for a generic rebuild.
limitations: The paired experiments do not establish that reuse is generally superior. No broad external adoption, product-market fit, UK partnership, or independent community impact is claimed. The clinics and Fellowship outcomes remain proposed work.
